ideas.title: Uncovering the $9B Somali Fraud Scandal in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the $9B Somali fraud scandal and the response of Minnesota Gov Walz and AG Ellison
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the handling of the scandal
questions: What was the extent of the fraud?
How did the AG's office handle the scandal?
ideas.insight: This story has high potential for uncovering corruption and abuse of power at the highest levels of Minnesota's government.

ideas.title: Medicaid Billing Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate Medicaid billing fraud in Minnesota and the role of personal care assistants
ideas.angle: Analyze Medicaid billing data to identify patterns of fraud
questions: How widespread is Medicaid billing fraud in Minnesota?
What role do personal care assistants play in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has potential for uncovering a larger pattern of Medicaid billing fraud in Minnesota.
